items.title: Sumner Labat Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: I'd get cornet and saxophone and play one or two musicians I'd get most of the time. Uh-huh. And I used to get Kid Rainey, Kid Howard, Kid Ricardo Alexis.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. Uh-huh. Let's see. Well, did, did you and Tio ever play together while he was in? No, I never did there with Tio. Oh.

But what, what sort of band you played with a long time ago? The Supreme Band was the band I played with. Uh-huh. And practically most of the fellas died and I formed my own band. That's why I started getting, uh, uh, fellas out of New Orleans to play with me. Uh-huh. Uh-huh. I'd get cornet and saxophone and play one or two musicians I'd get most of the time. Uh-huh. And I used to get Kid Rainey, Kid Howard, Kid Ricardo Alexis. Uh-huh. And, uh, I even had Celestan come out and try and play with me. Uh-huh.…
No, I went up and played sax and clarinet both.
